observations.exact_quote: Net fees for the year ended 30 June 2025 decreased by 11% on a like-for-like basis, and by 13% on a reported basis, to £972.4 million.
observations.locator: FY2025 Preliminary Results, Financial Review, Turnover and net fees. Most recent reported full-year net fees (£972.4m); FY2026 tracked down ~9% in H1 and ~5% LFL in Q4, so the FY2026 starting range is set below this base (880-920 GBPm) pending the 20 Aug 2026 full-year results.

observations.exact_quote: The Group's pre-exceptional basic earnings per share (EPS) of 1.31p was 67% lower than the prior year.
